watches.name: Adventurer-Call Of Duty
watches.description: Bahrami Call of Duty (Limited to 2 Pieces) Permanently sold out — this was a one-time release. Designed for those with a passion for military technology, aviation, and the bold spirit of adventure, the Bahrami Call of Duty is a timepiece that makes a statement. This watch is more than just a tribute; it’s a symbol of courage and precision, built for those who push the limits. The camouflage print dial captures the essence of military ingenuity, with its intricate design offering a dynamic, ever-changing pattern that reflects both the rugged terrain and the tactical expertise of those who wear it. The DLC-coated black case enhances its ruggedness while providing a sleek, stealthy appearance—perfect for the modern warrior. The grained texture on the dial further enhances the camouflage effect, offering depth and dimension with every glance. Encased in DLC-coated black stainless steel, the 42mm cushion case (12.3mm thick) houses a domed sapphire crystal with underside AR coating for optimal clarity. The screw-down crown, engraved with Bahrami’s signature “B,” ensures secure operation, while the 200 meters of water resistance guarantees reliability in extreme conditions. The sandwich dial construction, paired with BGW9 Swiss Super-LumiNova, offers superior legibility in any lighting, and the diamond-cut, polished anime sword hands provide a sharp contrast against the dial, ensuring precision and clarity. Each piece features an individually numbered caseback, marking its exclusivity. At its core, the Japan-regulated NH38 movement delivers unwavering precision and performance. The Bahrami Call of Duty comes with a durable handmade strap, custom-made in-house by Esfandiar Bahrami, offering a unique touch of personalization and exclusivity. Whether you choose the leather or rubber strap, both options are designed for comfort, longevity, and ultimate performance, ready for any challenge. Limited to just 2 pieces, this timepiece is as exclusive as it is bold. Please note: The straps shown are for display purposes only and are not the default option. Each purchase includes a fully customized handmade strap. After securing your piece, message us at @bahrami.watches or @bahrami_straps to begin the customization process.
